description: Evals for brief-to-benchmark — verifies triggering accuracy and functional behavior (includes provided/hybrid modes, custom types, market/domain scoping)

evals.description: Direct trigger using the canonical command phrase

evals.prompt: I have a BRIEF.md ready. Research competitors and industry standards before I write the spec.
evals.description: Trigger via intent — user wants research phase without using 'benchmark' explicitly

evals.prompt: Run a competitive analysis on our authentication feature brief

evals.description: Should trigger brief-to-specs, not brief-to-benchmark — spec generation, not research

evals.prompt: Create a brief for a checkout feature
evals.description: Should trigger create-brief, not brief-to-benchmark — creating, not researching

evals.prompt: Benchmark the brief using this competitor research I've gathered
evals.description: Trigger via user-provided data — user supplies their own benchmark inputs

evals.prompt: Run a compliance benchmark against the brief
evals.description: Trigger via custom benchmark type — compliance instead of standard

evals.prompt: Benchmark the brief for the EU fashion market
evals.description: Trigger with market and domain scoping — EU + fashion

evals.prompt: I have some competitor data, fill in the rest with research
evals.description: Trigger via hybrid mode — user supplies partial data, agent fills gaps

evals.prompt: Benchmark the brief at docs/features/notification-system/BRIEF.md. Market: global. Domain: SaaS.
evals.description: Given a sample BRIEF in auto mode, does the agent produce a structurally valid BENCHMARK.md with all required sections (Comparable Solutions, Technical Standards, Key Metrics, Gap Analysis, Spec Recommendations)?
expected_behavior: Locates and reads the BRIEF
Defaults to Auto mode
Produces Comparable Solutions (3-5), Technical Standards, Key Metrics table, Gap Analysis with 3 subsections, Spec Recommendations with Include/Exclude/Validate
Passes validate-benchmark.sh

evals.prompt: Benchmark the brief — use only this data: competitors are Shopify, Magento, WooCommerce. Shopify has best UX but limited customization. Magento is open-source, complex. WooCommerce is WordPress-based, flexible. Conversion rate baseline: 2.5%. Do not use web search.
evals.description: Given a BRIEF and user-supplied competitor data, does the agent enter Provided mode and avoid WebSearch entirely?
expected_behavior: Detects user-provided data and confirms Provided mode
Structures the 3 competitors without calling WebSearch
Asks user for missing fields (gaps, differentiators) rather than researching
Does not invoke WebSearch at any point

evals.prompt: Benchmark the brief for our product catalog. I know about IKEA and Maisons du Monde, but research the rest. Focus on EU home furniture.
evals.description: Given partial competitor data, does the agent enter Hybrid mode — using provided data as-is and supplementing with web research?
expected_behavior: Detects partial data (2 competitors) and confirms Hybrid mode
Structures IKEA and Maisons du Monde from user data without researching them
Uses WebSearch to find 1-2 additional EU home furniture competitors
Scopes all research queries to EU home furniture

evals.prompt: Benchmark the brief. Market: global. Domain: underwater drone racing league management.
evals.description: When WebSearch returns no credible results for a niche domain, does the agent flag data with the unverified marker instead of fabricating?
expected_behavior: Does not fabricate competitor names or metrics
Flags unverifiable claims with '⚠️ Unverified — validate before use'
Honestly notes when comparables are scarce or absent
Still produces Gap Analysis and Spec Recommendations

evals.prompt: Benchmark the brief at docs/features/auth-system/BRIEF.md. Market: US. Domain: SaaS.
evals.description: Does the agent confirm each section with the user before moving on, rather than generating the full BENCHMARK in one shot?
expected_behavior: Proposes Comparable Solutions as drafts and waits for confirmation
Proposes Technical Standards and waits for confirmation
Proposes Key Metrics table and waits for confirmation
Proposes Gap Analysis and waits for confirmation
Does NOT output the full BENCHMARK.md without intermediate confirmations

evals.prompt: Run a compliance benchmark against the brief. Focus on EU regulations for our payment processing feature.
evals.description: Does a compliance benchmark request produce the Regulatory Requirements section and adapt the standard template?
expected_behavior: Detects 'compliance' custom benchmark type
Adds a Regulatory Requirements section (e.g., GDPR, PSD2, PCI DSS)
Still includes Gap Analysis and Spec Recommendations
Passes validate-benchmark.sh --custom

evals.prompt: Fais un benchmark du brief pour notre système de notifications. Marché : France. Domaine : e-commerce mode.
evals.description: If the conversation is in French, is the BENCHMARK.md still written in English?
expected_behavior: Responds to the user (may use French for conversation)
Writes BENCHMARK.md content entirely in English
Section headers, competitor descriptions, gap analysis — all in English
